about.bio: I am a Principal Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in designing and implementing cloud-native applications. Skilled in various programming languages and frameworks, I have a proven track record of leading projects that enhance system performance and streamline workflows. My passion for mentoring engineers and delivering impactful solutions drives my commitment to excellence in software development.

philosophy.title: Cloud-Native Architecture
philosophy.desc: I design and implement cloud-native applications on AWS and Azure, using microservices, API Gateway, and Saga patterns to enable independent scaling and resilient deployments.

philosophy.title: Performance Engineering
philosophy.desc: I reduce response times by 40%+ through query optimization, caching strategies, cursor-based pagination, and efficient data pipelines in PostgreSQL and MySQL.

philosophy.title: Security & Reliability
philosophy.desc: I apply IAM governance, secrets management, and encryption standards. CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Kubernetes reduce deployment effort by 70% and improve reliability.

philosophy.title: Mentorship & Leadership
philosophy.desc: Engineering is a team sport. I lead cross-functional teams through sprint planning, code reviews, and mentoring — recognized as Best Performer of the Year at BJIT.

projects.title: E-parts – Catalog Management Platform
projects.stack: React · TypeScript · MUI · TanStack Query · SignalR · .NET 10 · Azure Functions · Fabric SQL · Dataverse · Azure Blob · Azure DevOps
bullets: Led full-stack delivery of a scalable mill data platform covering sync, BOM management, and real-time collaborative editing.
Built React/TypeScript UI with TanStack Query and lazy BOM loading — reduced API calls by ~60–70% and improved large-table render speed by ~80–90%.
Implemented Azure SignalR locks for concurrent editing to prevent data conflicts across multiple users.
Built Azure Functions (.NET 10) with Durable Functions for Fabric → Dataverse sync — ~40–60% faster large-mill sync and ~50–90% less repeat sync data via delta sync.
Optimized Dataverse bulk writes with streaming pipelines; delivered BOM, Translations, Mill Search, Excel import, Activity Log, and Action Server integrations.

projects.title: Shin Sagantosu Fan Token – Store Discovery Platform
projects.stack: React · NestJS · TypeScript · Redux · React Query · Tailwind CSS · Google Maps API · AWS S3 · Amplify · DynamoDB · RDS
bullets: Led full-stack development from design to production deployment, delivering a scalable platform serving 500+ stores.
Architected React/TypeScript frontend with Redux and React Query, ensuring state persistence and shareable filter URLs.
Implemented Google Maps integration with custom marker clustering, dynamic bounds fitting, and resolved race condition bugs via ref-based state tracking.
Built admin panel with CRUD, bulk CSV import, multi-image upload (AWS S3), and concurrent request handling.
Designed API layer with debounced search, auto-complete, campaign filtering, and caching — reducing API calls by 60%.
Owned CI/CD deployment workflows on AWS Amplify with DynamoDB and RDS for high-availability data persistence.

projects.title: Mitsubishi Logistic – Warehouse Monitoring
projects.stack: NestJS · Node.js · Express · React · Redux · Docker · API Gateway · Kafka · RabbitMQ · Microservices
bullets: Built microservices backend (NestJS) processing 10M+ records/day, cutting batch processing time from 3 hours → 40 minutes.
Integrated Kafka and RabbitMQ for async analytics pipelines, enabling near real-time productivity insights across warehouses.
Applied API Gateway for unified access and authentication, reducing integration overhead by 30%.
Optimized performance service with caching and pipelines, lowering latency by 45% under peak loads.
Developed React/Redux dashboards for KPIs (throughput, downtime, utilization), reducing manual reporting by 70%.
Containerized services with Docker, enabling independent scaling and fault-tolerant deployments.

projects.title: A-B Will Vote – Online Voting & Social Platform
projects.stack: Node.js · Express · React · Redux · React Hooks · AWS EC2 · AWS S3 · MySQL · Jest
bullets: Built Node.js/Express backend APIs powering voting, content management, and social features at scale.
Developed React frontend with Hooks and Redux for scalable, predictable state management.
Delivered core features: multi-option questions, file/video uploads, social login (Facebook/LinkedIn), follow/unfollow, comments, and category-based search.
Engineered buffered video streaming with back-pressure handling, ensuring smooth playback and preventing memory overload under peak usage.
Enhanced admin panel with question sorting, category management, pro-user controls, and moderation tools.
Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest, ensuring reliability and maintainability.

projects.title: BMS – Biomedical Management System
projects.stack: CakePHP 5.x · PHP 8.1+ · MySQL · jQuery · Bootstrap · D3.js · DataTables · FullCalendar · PHPUnit · i18n
bullets: Developed a CakePHP 5.x system to manage material preservation, manufacturing workflows, and multi-facility operations.
Built modular backend APIs for approval workflows, material tracking, room reservations, and process step management.
Designed interactive frontend with jQuery, Bootstrap, FullCalendar, and D3.js for scheduling, drag-and-drop reservations, and workflow analytics.
Implemented RBAC with granular permissions, QR/barcode tracking, PDF reporting, and multi-language support (English/Japanese).
Migrated codebase from CakePHP 4.x → 5.x, ensuring PHP 8.1+ compatibility and improved performance.
Wrote comprehensive PHPUnit test suites for controllers, models, and components.
